_comment: Command-palette parity ratchet. excluded = deliberately out of the palette, not merely unbuilt (app lifecycle / streaming / internal-onboarding helpers / pure duplicates of already-exposed ops, not standalone request/response forms — plus ops withheld on security grounds; see the per-ticket comments below). deferred = registered commands not YET exposed in the palette; remove each entry as its manifest/<domain>/<op>.ts lands. CI fails if a registered command is in neither the manifest nor this file, or if a deferred entry is already covered/gone.
_sbai_5484_comment: context_get, context_select, context_update, and context_validate are internal context-controller IPC, not standalone user operations; context_select requires a complete validated context, typed target, and concurrency generation and is used only by ContextProvider.
_sbai_5910_comment: auth_login_with_token is excluded on security grounds, not deferred: pasted-bearer login reached upstream with an empty auth_url, so the token was delivered to whatever authentication endpoint the user-supplied untrusted remote advertised, before any JWT audience validation. The command stays registered so direct IPC hits its constant denial, and the GUI offers no form that collects a token. The exclusion holds until a REVIEWED restoration lands under SBAI-5919, which owns restoration behind a trusted, label-bound IdP; re-adding a manifest entry outside that ticket is forbidden and is caught by the palette manifest ban test (frontend/src/palette/manifest.spec.ts). Until then, use auth_login_interactive.
